content: Kirstoosa Denth
Intte qohida qoho gishshassinne intte nagara gaason intte hayqqideta shin;
hessa intte hayssa alameza iita oge kaallideta; bolla carko bolla diidi haariza wolqqama ayanatas ha7ikka Xoossas azazettontta asaa bolla ooththiza iita ayanas intte azazettishe gam7ideta.
Hayssafe kase nuni nu asho amoteth polishe ashoy koyza oge kaallishe isttara doos; nunikka hankko asa mala nu medheteththafe Xoossa hanqo garsan de7oos.
Gido attiin Xoossi keehi siiqida gishshas ba maaro daron nuni nu qoho daroteththaan hayqqidayta gidi dishin Kirstoosa baggara nuna ashshides; intte paxiday iza kiyateththanna.
Xoossi nuna Kirstoosara gaththi denththides; Yesus Kirstoosa baggara nuna salon banara utissides.
Hessika hayssafe guye yaana wodezan Yesus Kirstoosi nuus ba kiyateththan qonccisida zaway baynda ba kiyateththa dureteththaa nuna bessanaassa.
Intte Xoossa kiyateththan ammanon attideta; hessika Xoossi inttes mela coo immidazaappe attiin intte oosoppe gidenna.
Oonikka ceeqettontta mala oosoppe gidenna.
Hessika Xoossi kase koyro giigsi woththida lo7o ooso nuni ooththana mala Yesus Kirstoosa baggara nuni nam7anththo medhettidaytanne Xoossa medheteththata.
Kirstoosan Beettiza Issifeteth

Hessa gishshas intte kase intte yeleteththan Ayzaabeti intte asateththa bolla asa kushe ooso gaason, «Nuni qaxxarettidos» giza asati inttena, «Qaxxarettonttayta» gizaytoo! Intte hessa ane wozinan woththite.
Intte he wode Kirstoosappe shaakettidi, Isra7eele naytappe haakkidi, caaqo qaalaska allaga gididi, hayssa alameza bolla hidotaynne Xoossi baynda kase intte diza duussaa yuushshi qopite.
Ha7i qasse intte kase haahon dizayti Yesus Kirstoosan gididi iza suuththaa baggara shiiqideta.
Nam7ata issi bolla gaththidi giddon shaakki ooshshiza miishshaa laallida nu saroy iza.
Wogaa, woga azazora gaththi issife ba ashon shaarides; izi hessa ooththida gaasoykka izas waanna qofay nam7atappe issi ooraththa as ba baggara medhdhidi saroteth ehanaassa.
Izi masqale bolla hayqqidi morkketeth diggides; nam7atakka issi asho histtidi Xoossara maqayinththides.
Izi yiidi inttes haakki dizaytassinne matan dizaytas gaththi saroteth sabbakides.
Nu wurikka iza baggara issi Ayanan Aawaa ach shiiqana.
Hessa gishshas intte ammanizaytara issife issi dere asanne Xoossas soo asa attiin hayssafe guye betetanne imaththata gidekketa.
Intte Hawaaretanne nabeta yochchan keexettideta; keeththaas wurseththa kuushshay Yesus Kirstoosa.
Keeththazi wurikka issife oykettidi Godaas dumma keeththe gidanaas diccees.
Intteka Xoossi ba Ayanan daanaas izas duussaso gidana mala issife keexettishe deeta.
